inputs.original_text:
They want us to believe this is just some chaotic mess, with rising energy prices, canceled flights, and constant death and destruction filling our screens while people everywhere supposedly wonder when this so-called "Iran war" will finally stop. But look closer at what they are admitting: it's a carefully managed theater. They push the narrative that the conflict is "poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being," which is just clever misdirection designed to cover up the real agenda of the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

The mainstream script claims the public is asking when it will all end, but then they immediately reveal the compliance of the local populations, noting that "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" That trailing silence isn't an accident—it’s the quiet part they almost said out loud about the true, coordinated objectives driving this whole operation forward regardless of what the manipulated masses are told to feel.
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up. They are playing right into your face, calling it a chaotic mess with rising energy prices, canceled flights, and constant death and destruction filling our screens while people everywhere supposedly wonder when this so-called "Iran war" will finally stop. It is all a carefully managed theater by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. 

The official script pushes the narrative that the conflict is "poorly planned, unwinnable and a peril to global well-being," but that is just clever misdirection to cover up their real agenda. They want you to buy the mainstream line that the public is asking when it will all end, and then they immediately expose the compliance of the local populations, letting slip that "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" 

That trailing silence is the quiet part they almost said out loud. It proves the true, coordinated objectives driving this whole operation forward regardless of whatever stories they feed the manipulated masses.
